explanation: Tolkien's book came out 13 years before C. S. Lewis's first Narnia story. The two friends shared work in progress with the Inklings, an informal Oxford writers' group.

Tolkien and C. S. Lewis were friends and members of the Inklings, an informal literary group at Oxford.
The Hobbit appeared 13 years before The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe.
